title: fix(plugin-form): a record dialog with no authored layout opens bounded with a two-column grid (objectui#12521)
body:
Fixes #12521
Clause-②: no. No type, prop, export or spec declaration changes: the console's interim is one module-private function in `AppContent.tsx`, and the dialog's new helpers are module-private in `ModalForm.tsx`.

Implemented by the dispatched dev of the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM loop, rework round 1, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`. It executes letter B (comment 6203721639), its section-`columns` fork (6204264665) and the interim ruled in 6205068311 on the maintainer's 「可以，12521 走快速方案」. This PR now closes the card. The interim's deletion is a follow-up card the seat files.

## What lands

### 1. The console's interim desktop bound (`@object-ui/app-shell`)

- `deriveRecordFlowSurface` (installed `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.1, re-exported by `@object-ui/plugin-view`) answers `size: 'full'` for a create, edit, child-create or child-edit flow on an object with 12 or more authorable fields. `AppContent` spread that into `modalSize: 'full'`, so HotCRM Leads → New opened at 1368 × 810 (95vw).
- One module-private function, `interimBoundedTaskFlowSurface`, now wraps the derivation's answer at its one call site. It maps `size: 'full'` to `size: 'auto'`, the shape letter B makes the spec derive (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23734). So the dialog is handed no derived `modalSize`, and `ModalForm`'s own bounded default decides: `xl` or `lg`, never `full`.
- Its docblock cites the interim (6205068311) and names its exit: delete the function and call `deriveRecordFlowSurface` directly once objectui installs a spec carrying objectstack-ai/objectstack#23734.
- **The exit is pinned.** `AppContent.recordDialogInterimBound-12521.test.tsx` calls the installed `deriveRecordFlowSurface` for a 14-field object on a desktop `create` flow, the way `AppContent` calls it (no viewport). While it answers `full`, the test asserts the interim applies. Once it answers anything else, the test fails with a message naming the deletion. So the bump that installs the new spec cannot land with the interim in place. There is no skip or todo; it is a real assertion today.
- **Phone: no posture check is needed** (A1 below). The phone sheet is `ModalForm`'s own presentation below `sm`, and no `modalSize` reaches it.

### 2. The dialog's own defaults (`@object-ui/plugin-form`, `ModalForm`)

- **Size** (round 1, unchanged). With no `modalSize`, the dialog picks `lg` or `xl` from the grid it renders and its field count, never `full`. The rule is `inferModalSize(min(columns, inferColumns(fieldCount)))`. An authored `modalSize`, `'full'` included, is used as written.
- **Flat grid** (round 1, unchanged). A form with no `columns` and no sections draws two per row from the container's `@md` tier (`grid gap-4 grid-cols-1 @md:grid-cols-2`). Each field takes one cell; a wide kind or a `span: 'full'` field takes the row. The object's `fieldGroups` fallback lays out the same way.
- **Section density** (new, the fork's renderer side). In a form that declares no `columns`, a section that declares none draws two per row from `@md`. A declared count, `1` included, is drawn as written. The rule lives in two module-private helpers:
  - `dialogSectionColumns` gives a section's count: declared, else the form's declared `columns`, else 2;
  - `sectionedDialogColumns` gives the grid width: the form's `columns`, else the widest section count.

  Both feed objectui#12548's `sectionedGridLayout`. When every count fits the widest grid, the grid stays `CONTAINER_GRID_COLS`'. Otherwise it switches to the 12-track grid, where an undeclared section's fields span 6 at `@md` and a wide kind or `span: 'full'` spans 12. Below `@md` it is one column, as before.
  - Undeclared beside `columns: 1`: the grid is two wide; the undeclared fields take one cell, the `columns: 1` fields `@md:col-span-2`.
  - Undeclared beside `columns: 3`: `grid gap-4 grid-cols-1 @md:grid-cols-12`. The undeclared fields carry `@md:col-span-6`, two per row at every tier. The `columns: 3` fields carry `@md:col-span-6 @2xl:col-span-4`.
  - A form-level `columns` still sets an undeclared section's count, exactly as before.
  - Everything declared draws the classes `main` draws.

### 3. The merge with `main`

`main` was merged in as a merge commit (no rebase, no force-push). `ModalForm.tsx` conflicted with PR #12556 (objectui#12548, the per-section 12-track grid) and PR #12571 (objectui#12559, the dialog-owned `Suspense`). The resolution keeps both landed behaviours: every sectioned dialog lays out through `sectionedGridLayout`, and the body's `Suspense` boundary is untouched. The round-1 CONTROL pin (a HotCRM-shaped `columns: 2` + `columns: 3` form) now asserts the classes PR #12556 draws on `main`.

## Measurements behind the route

- **A1, the phone path.** `AppContent` calls the derivation with no `viewport`, so it only ever receives the desktop answer. Every `ModalForm` size class is `sm:`-prefixed (`sm:max-w-2xl`, `sm:max-w-5xl`, `sm:max-w-[95vw] sm:w-full`). `MobileDialogContent`'s base classes are `fixed inset-0 w-full h-[100dvh]`. So below `sm` the dialog is a full-screen sheet whatever `modalSize` says.
  - Pinned: the real dialog's classes with no responsive prefix are identical with the interim and under the old `modalSize: 'full'`.
  - Measured in Chromium at 390 × 844: both are 390 × 844 at (0, 0), and every field is 358 px wide, one per row.
  - So the interim needs no posture signal, and it carries none.
- **A2, where the section default is applied: upstream, at the authoring producer.** `@objectstack/spec` `FormSectionSchema.columns` is `.default(1)`. Probed on the installed spec 18.0.0-next.1, a section with no `columns`:
  - `FormViewSchema.parse` answers `[1, 1, 3]` for sections declaring nothing, `1` and `3`;
  - `defineView`, the call HotCRM's `lead.view.ts` uses, answers `[1, 1, 3]` too;
  - `defineStack` in strict mode returns the parse's `result.data`.

  objectui never parses form views client-side; `resolveFormViewLayout` hands `objectDef.form.sections` through as served. So a section from an authored stack reaches the dialog DECLARED `columns: 1` and draws one column. **The undeclared rule is correct but takes effect only after the spec drops the default (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23740).** It is not worked around: a declared `1` is never read as undeclared, and a pin holds that. NOT MEASURED: the HTTP leg (a live server's served JSON), and whether a view saved through the metadata API at runtime is parsed on save. Neither objectstack nor hotcrm is installed in this container.
- **A3, the merge.** Resolved as above; PR #12556's and PR #12571's own pins were re-run as CONTROLs, all green (see Tests).
- **A4, the no-section default against `default(1)`.** With the fork ruled, the only remaining question is A2. A form with no sections never meets `FormSectionSchema`, so its two-per-row default is unaffected. The fieldGroups fallback stamps its own `columns` on the sections it derives, so it is unaffected too.

## Tests (local, head `91fd2dbe68`)

Every vitest run went through objectstack's `os-verify-lock.sh`.

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.recordDialogInterimBound-12521.test.tsx` (new, 8 cases), on a real `AppContent` mount with the real `ModalForm` where a case reads the dialog:
  - the 14-field object is field-heavy (the installed `deriveRecordSurface` pages it);
  - desktop `create`: no `modalSize` is handed over, and the dialog is `sm:max-w-5xl`, not `sm:max-w-[95vw]`;
  - `edit`, `child-create` and `child-edit`: no derived `modalSize` is handed over;
  - phone: the classes that apply below `sm` are identical to those of the old 95vw dialog, the sheet's `fixed inset-0 w-full h-[100dvh]` included, and no `max-w-*` reaches a phone;
  - CONTROL: a `modalSize: 'full'` handed to the dialog still opens at 95vw;
  - EXIT: the installed derivation still answers `full`, and while it does the interim applies.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/dialogDefaultLayout-12521.test.tsx` (14 cases, 5 new): the round-1 cases; the CONTROL re-expressed on PR #12556's classes; and the density cases. Those are: undeclared beside `columns: 1`; undeclared beside `columns: 3` on the 12-track grid; a `columns: 3` section draws three; every section at `columns: 1` (what the spec's parse writes today) draws one column; and a form-level `columns` still sets an undeclared section's count.
- **Ablation** of the interim: `interimBoundedTaskFlowSurface` made the identity through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `91e724d1d8` → `a9cf6e490d`), trap-protected. Result: **5 failed, 3 passed**.
  - Red: the create, edit, child-create and child-edit cells, and the EXIT cell, each at `expected 'full' to be undefined`.
  - Green: the precondition, the phone cell and the authored-size CONTROL.
  - Restore proven: the blob equals HEAD (`91e724d1d8`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **The exit message, simulated once.** The exit cell's own read was mutated to answer `size: 'auto'`, as a spec carrying objectstack-ai/objectstack#23734 would. The cell then fails with: "The installed @objectstack/spec no longer derives `size: 'full'` for a field-heavy desktop task flow: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23734 is installed. Delete the interim `interimBoundedTaskFlowSurface` in packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx, call `deriveRecordFlowSurface` directly at its call site, and delete this file (objectui#12521, interim ruled in comment 6205068311).: expected 'auto' to be 'full'". Restore was proven the same way. No permanent test file.
- CONTROLs plus the new pins in one run, 8 files, **123 passed**:
  - PR #12556's `mixedSectionColumns-12548.test.tsx` and `form-twelve-track-span-12548.test.tsx`;
  - PR #12571's `modalSectionToggleSuspense-12559.test.tsx` and `sectionedFormValues.test.tsx`;
  - the two new pin files, `autoLayout.test.ts` and `plugin-view`'s `recordSurface.test.ts`.
- The whole `packages/plugin-form/` plus `form-twelve-track-span-12548.test.tsx`: **187 files, 2294 passed, 1 skipped**, vitest exit 0.
- Dialog hosts plus the census and ratchet sweep, **88 files, 2558 passed**, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The set is:
  - every `packages/app-shell` and `apps/console` test that `git grep -l -E "ModalForm|useActionModal|openRecordForm|form=new|createTitle|editTitle|formType: .modal.|resolveFormViewLayout|deriveRecordFlowSurface"` finds on the merged tree (40, the new file included);
  - the designer `ObjectManager` tests and `ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx`;
  - the `packages/types` files that read `ModalForm`, and `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView.formTitleI18n` and `recordSurface` tests;
  - the 43 census and ratchet files (`git grep -l -E "census|ratchet|WRITE_SITES|AFFORDANCE_GRANTS"`) whose subject this diff touches (`AppContent`, `ModalForm`, `autoLayout`, the changesets, the docs page).
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` (29 packages, `VERDICT command-exit 0`). Each runs `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose include `src/**/*.test.tsx` covers both pin files.

## Gates (local subset, each exit code captured before any pipe)

All exit 0:
- changeset gates: `check-changeset-presence` ("6 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 2 changeset(s)"), `-no-major`, `-overwrite`, `-fixed`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`;
- `check:control-bytes` and `check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)");
- doc gates: `check:doc-snippets` ("796 of 796 block(s) judged, 0 failed"), `check-doc-links`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-json`, `check:doc-types`, `check-doc-expression-carriage`, `check:doc-example-ids`. `check:doc-snippets` first answered PRECONDITION NOT MET (exit 2, read as not measured) and passed after its scoped build;
- `check:spec-symbols`, `check:installed-pin-claims`;
- `check-test-path-roots` and the three `vi.mock` gates;
- eslint on the six changed TS files: 0 errors, warnings only, all `no-explicit-any`;
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the nine paths: NOT GOVERNED.

Left to CI: the full farm, including repo-wide `pnpm lint` and `performance-budget`.

## What the landing seat's browser reading should show

Expected values below come from the DOM the real `ModalForm` renders for a HotCRM-Leads-shaped form (sections `columns` 2 / 3 / 2 / 1 / 2, `last_name` `span: 'full'`). It was measured in headless Chromium against a Tailwind 4.3.3 compile of that DOM's own classes, not the console's full sheet.

- **HotCRM Leads → New at 1440 × 900:** the dialog is within the `xl` bound, 1024 × 810 (it was 1368 × 810). The sections are drawn as authored:
  - Contact Information two per row, 455 px each, with `last_name` on its own row at 926 px;
  - Lead Classification three per row, 298 px each;
  - a `columns: 2` section two per row; Additional Information (`columns: 1`) one per row.

  Collapsed sections open in place.
- **At 390 × 844:** the sheet is unchanged. It is a full-screen 390 × 844 sheet with every field 358 px wide, one per row, the same as before the interim.
- **Between `sm` and `xl`:** at a 1024-wide window the dialog fills the width, 1024 px (it was 973 px at 95vw).

## Acceptance notes

- **The undeclared-section rule is dormant on authored stacks until objectstack-ai/objectstack#23740** (A2). Today every parsed section carries `columns: 1` and draws one column. This PR does not work around that.
- **While the interim stands, it also bounds a field-heavy form with an embedded child table.** Letter B item 2 asks the spec seat to measure that case first, and the spec may keep it full-screen. On the exit, whatever objectstack-ai/objectstack#23734 derives takes over.
- **The console's global record dialog reads neither `FormView.modalSize` nor `FormView.columns`.** `resolveFormViewLayout` passes sections, `contentLayout` and subforms only. So "an authored form-view size still wins" has no path at this host, before or after this PR. No producer writes `FormView.modalSize`: zero hits in hotcrm, objectstack `examples/`, and objectui `examples/` and `apps/`. Noted, not filed; carrier: none (承接者:无).
- **The other sectioned hosts keep an undeclared section at the grid's width**, single-column when nothing declares a count. That is `ObjectForm`'s page form, `SplitForm`, `TabbedForm` and `WizardForm`. This round is dialog-only, as round 1 was. Once objectstack-ai/objectstack#23740 lands, those hosts will meet undeclared sections too. Noted for the follow-up; carrier: the seat.
- **The PR title still names `plugin-form` only.** The title is outside this round's write budget.
- From round 1, still standing: `plugin-form.mdx`'s "single-column in every host" sentence is loose for `ObjectForm`'s simple path, which falls back to `inferColumns`.
